hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 identified through ROM

inputs.name: RAM firmware FIT with OpenSBI and U-Boot
Static FFS RAM root filesystem
inputs.revision: Modified OS worktree based on efe18759405516fc3925570e07d0094eabc7ad3a; source-worktree SHA256 5109cdc1237b3e64c1474c52dee421c2243b0068c9e5a42dc072a68d66b50c13; console producer published at 27242ccd8e397de27e50b57589d3d4c97e4ca5e1

scenario: Start the RAM-only SPL using the vendor ROM and transfer firmware. Use U-Boot YMODEM at 460800 baud to load the kernel FIT and RAM root, returning the console to 115200 after each transfer. Boot in single-user mode with an in-place memory-disk root, and exercise console input and output, a child shell and interrupt delivery.
expected: The kernel starts with its memory-disk root and provides an interactive single-user shell on UART.
observed: Both YMODEM transfers completed with 460800/115200 baud transitions. The kernel attached its timer and interrupt matrix, mounted an FFS root on md0a and reached a single-user shell. Console input and output worked; /sbin/init and /bin/sh were present, a child shell executed, and Ctrl-C returned to the prompt.
limits: This is one operator-reported V1.2 sample and silicon revision 0.0; other units and revisions were not tested.
Boot and root storage were RAM-only; persistent NOR or NAND boot, recovery and operation across power cycles were not tested.
This is not a full-range PSRAM read/write test or a sustained reliability test.
A child shell and a single Ctrl-C were observed; this does not establish complete POSIX, PTY, signal or application support.
FIT SHA-256 checks integrity and does not establish authenticated firmware.
The UART log and device identifiers remain private; raw logs and identifiers are not published.
